Name: Ranged Machine Interactions
Author: rokugin
Description:
[size=5][u]Install[/u][/size][size=3]
1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI﻿[/url].
2. [size=3]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/size]
3. Run the game using SMAPI.

[/size][size=5][u]About[/u][/size][size=3]
Allows you to manually load or collect from any machine at range that you can see.

I tried to keep the default behavior to favor every other kind of interaction before the machine. So if you're facing a door and you right click a machine it will use the door rather than the machine.

There's one config option to make it so machine interaction is favored over any other action. So if you're facing a door and you right click a machine, it won't use the door even if there's nothing to collect or add to the machine.

[/size][size=5][u]Known Issues[/u][/size][size=3]
Base controller functionality is a bit bad when it comes to diagonal interactions, trying to see if I can do something about this.

[/size][size=5][u]Compatibility[/u][/size][size=3]
Hopefully none, but let me know.

[url=https://github.com/rokugin/RangedMachineInteractions]Source[/url]
[/size]
